parts.description: Walk slowly for 2 minutes to warm up.
Walk comfortably for 6 minutes, then slow down for 2 minutes.

events.description: Warm up with 2 minutes of gentle marching. Complete the exercises, then walk slowly for 2 minutes to cool down.

exercises.name: Chair squat
exercises.description: Sit back toward a stable chair and stand slowly. Rest 30 seconds between sets. Allow 3 minutes including rest.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.description: Keep your body straight and bend the elbows toward the wall. Rest 30 seconds between sets. Allow 3 minutes including rest.
